name: Model Explorer
summary:
Model Explorer is a local-first workspace for reviewing 3D assets on Meta Quest.
Import GLB, glTF folders assets, keep a reusable model library on your
device, and open a model in mixed reality when you are ready.

Inspect scale and form in context:

- Place, rotate, and scale models in your space
- Switch between original, wireframe, and UV views
- Use hand tracking or Touch controllers
- Keep imported models in local app storage by default
- Create a share link only when you explicitly choose Share
- Use
